_comment: Cupcake Thread Router Config. Copy to ~/.openclaw/thread-routing.json and fill in your Telegram chat IDs.
_howto: 1. Get your Telegram group chat_id: forward any message from the group to @userinfobot
2. For topic threads, open the thread and look at the URL: ?thread=<thread_id>
3. For user DMs, message @userinfobot to get your user_id
4. Each 'context' value is a namespace - messages in the same context share memory
5. Routes are matched most-specific first (chat_id+thread_id beats chat_id alone)
